speaker: will_kemp
text: You are out of the old man. You played him, and you did not ask me for a jig on the back of him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am out of him. I am not opening a book with you. We were civil on Saturday. I am civil now.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The bill is walked. Nothing was bought. The Rose has a Venetian comedy this afternoon. You are still here, so you are not over the water.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not over the water. I have been Egeon since two. That is the afternoon I had.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then go and eat, Will. I have no line to sell you today, and I will not pretend I have. You may keep your civility. I am keeping mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are both civil, and there is no tally. I am going to eat.
